look: Flintjaw Ripper, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Flintjaws family: soldier-caste insect with mandibles like flint axes and heavier armour. Family anatomy: armoured burrowing insects with flint-like mandibles and segmented chitin. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are ember-orange flint crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, modest embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
